notes.title: Small fixes and changes
notes.content:
Hey racers, we updated the game by making some small fixes and changes.
Here's a list of the stuff we did:
-Sometimes a white writing in the Open World Hub appeared in the lower zone of the screen and that should be fixed.
-Moved some writings in the Minikhana Tutorial to make them more visible (the one that explains how to change camera mainly).
-Fixed an issue with some events covers from Season 5 to the Final Race. Now the proper cover should be displayed in each season menu.
-Some "Retry buttons" in the special events reloaded a different scene and now the proper scene should be reloaded.
-There's a stuttering issue with the car that sometimes occurs. In some cases the problem never appears, while in other cases appears frequently in a single session. Now it should be less noticeable and it should appear less frequently (if it ever appeared to you).
-2 events from season 2 (Tropico Sprint 2 and Tropico Circuit 3) should be a little more difficult.
